Dry-Type Transformer

SC(B)14/18 Dry-Type Energy-Saving Transformer

New energy-saving dry-type transformer series developed in line with GB20052-2024.

Product Tags

SC(B)14SC(B)18Energy-saving dry-type
Back to product matrix

Overview

SC(B)14 and SC(B)18 dry-type energy-saving transformers are described as a new series developed according to the Transformer Energy Efficiency Enhancement Plan and GB20052-2024. Products can be equipped with vacuum on-load voltage regulation or intelligent units according to user requirements.

Applications

  • Power grid distribution
  • Real estate power distribution
  • Industrial and mining enterprises

Key Features

  • Energy-saving, environmentally friendly and green
  • Low loss and low noise
  • Good crack resistance
  • Maintenance-free
  • Moisture-proof, mildew-proof and anti-fouling
  • Strong short-circuit resistance

Product Advantages

  • Grade 2 and grade 1 energy-efficiency product series are referenced
  • Optional vacuum on-load voltage regulation and intelligent unit are referenced

Related Knowledge

Questions to confirm before project selection

FAQ

What is transformer K-factor?

K-factor indicates the transformer's ability to carry specified nonlinear load currents without exceeding its thermal limits.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What transformer is suitable for a data center?

Data center transformer selection usually emphasizes fire safety, harmonic loading, efficiency, reliability, noise and integration with busway or switchgear.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

Cast resin vs VPI dry-type transformer: what is the difference?

Cast resin embeds the winding in a solid resin body, while VPI impregnates the winding insulation with varnish under vacuum and pressure.
